functions.name: Base layer framework rows
functions.description: The privileged, framework-only base layer: framework SqlTable sets and base.contract.json guarantees (permission groups, countries, shop, order flows, number counters) that every addition binds to, delivered onto a blank DW10 database.

functions.name: Edition composition delivered
functions.description: An edition (base-only, base-swift, swift-demo, headless-demo, dap-portal) composes the base, ordered feature layers, surfaces, the sampleData toggle and themes; its expectedCounts and criticalPaths are the acceptance of a delivery.

functions.name: Sample data layer
functions.description: The one sample-data layer on the sampleData toggle: the browsable catalogue, three personas on one B2B account, orders, quotes, carts, storefront copy, the demo clock and email statistics.

notApplicable.when: the edition sets sampleData false (base-only, base-swift)

functions.name: Default theme with brand slot
functions.description: theme-default, the one disk-only presentation layer, shipping Custom/brand.css loaded after default_custom.css and brand.tokens.json for a demo-local re-skin.

notApplicable.when: the edition sets no themes (base-only, headless-demo)

functions.name: Release compatibility stamp
functions.description: layers/INDEX.json gateProven records the proven DW milestone and ring, apps and Swift version per edition; base.contract.json compat carries the floors (DW, Swift, Truvio.Commerce.Serializer required, Truvio.Commerce.MCP optional). A consumer pins main, asserts gateProven is present and resolves retired layer names to their successor.

functions.name: Artifact verification
functions.description: Published databases (blank and per edition) carry a sha256 in layers/INDEX.json bacpacs and are verified before restore; each proven layer carries a provenTree hash (layer-tree/v1) that must equal its tree.

notApplicable.when: the build restores no bacpac and delivers by deserialize from a locked commit (the tree hash check still applies through release-compatibility)
